submitted.rationale: Of the three merit measurements, the highest photocurrent was 7.9e-7 A at Ca0.50Mn0.50 (index 10). The Mn-rich end (index 24, Mn 0.80) gave 4.8e-7 A and the Ca-rich side (index 2, Mn 0.34) fell to 8e-8 A. So the photocurrent peaks near the 1:1 composition. XRD at Mn 0.34, 0.50 and 0.65 showed the same dominant reflection (Q≈2.784), so it did not separate the phases.
